name: mv
porting_notes: Cross-volume move implemented via copy-and-delete fallback (rename() fails across volumes on AmigaOS). fchmod/fchown are no-op stubs (AmigaOS has no POSIX permission model). fastcopy_bp memory leak on error path fixed by memory-checker audit. Perf-optimizer: CLEAN. All 20 FS-UAE tests pass.
known_limitations: Directory cross-volume moves are not supported (AmigaOS restriction). The -v flag shows files moved but AmigaDOS does not support POSIX-style verbose rename output for cross-volume operations.
readme:
Short:        Move or rename files
Type:         util/cli
Architecture: m68k-amigaos >= 3.0
Uploader:     duncan (at) bowring (dot) us
Author:       Ken Smith, UC Berkeley (ported by Duncan Bowring)
Version:      1.47

mv - Move or rename files

Original author: Ken Smith, UC Berkeley
Source: OpenBSD mv v1.47

Ported by Duncan Bowring using amiport (AI-assisted porting toolkit).
Project: https://github.com/bdgscotland/amiport

Cross-compiled with m68k-amigaos-gcc for AmigaOS 3.x (68000+).
Tested in FS-UAE with AmigaOS 3.1.

Usage:
  mv [-fiv] source target
  mv [-fiv] source ... directory

Options:
  -f   Force (do not prompt before overwriting)
  -i   Interactive (prompt before overwriting)
  -v   Verbose (show files as they are moved)

Cross-volume moves supported for regular files.
Directory cross-volume moves are not supported.

Includes full source code (original OpenBSD and ported Amiga versions)
and PORT.md documenting every transformation applied.
